# Shekhani LLC: Premier B2B Wholesale Marketplace & Supply Chain Distributor

## Company Overview
Shekhani LLC is a top tier American B2B wholesale marketplace distributor headquartered in Chesterfield, Missouri, USA. We connect verified retail store owners, boutique buyers, and brand manufacturers with nationwide logistics and wholesale inventory.

## Key Company Metrics
* Distribution Facility: Centralized Warehouse in Chesterfield 63017 MO US
* Verified Retail Store Partners: Over 1,000 active retail accounts
* Fulfillment Timelines: 24 to 48 business hour ground shipping dispatch
* On time Delivery Rate: 99.4% nationwide shipping performance
* Contact Email: sales@shekhanillc.com
* Address: Chesterfield 63017 MO US
